parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the four rotation lids of the box made of cardboard, forming the top flaps that can open or close.
parts.Functional_description: It helps cover and protect the contents of the box when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the top edge of the box to open or close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid flap of the box made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with other flaps to seal the box when folded inward.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line to open or close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the third rotation lid flap of the box made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to the closure and protection of the box’s contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates outward or inward to open or close the box.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth rotation lid flap of the box made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It completes the top closure of the box when folded inward.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its fold line to open or close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main base body of the box made of cardboard, forming the container’s structure.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the contents of the box, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it supports the rotation lids.
